General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Predictions are rough estimates, not reliable for contraception or conception planning.

📖 How to use

  1. Log the start date of each period.
  2. After 2+ entries, see your average cycle length.
  3. Check the predicted next period date.
  4. View the estimated fertile window.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is cycle length calculated?

The average of the gaps between logged start dates. Log at least 3 periods for a steadier average.

How is the fertile window estimated?

Ovulation is estimated ~14 days before the next period; the fertile window covers 5 days before to 1 day after ovulation.

Can I rely on these predictions?

It is a rough estimate for awareness only — not reliable for contraception or conception planning. Talk to a clinician.
